resources.string: Invite someone from the Contacts tab: they get a link or a QR code to open, then you can message each other.
Invalid recipient key: message not saved.
Key not verified: compare the fingerprint with your contact, or exchange an invitation.
Your contact is not connected. The message will be delivered when they come back (kept up to 24 h by the relay, and resent by your phone until delivered).
Have them scan this QR code with their camera, or share the link. They will join your group and can message you.
Join me on MESHORA (encrypted messaging, test version): %1$s
This link is not a valid MESHORA invitation.
Join their group? You will leave your current group. Your identity, contacts and messages are kept.
You are already in this group. Add %1$s to your verified contacts?
Warning: this invitation uses a relay other than MESHORA\'s: %1$s
%1$s is now in your verified contacts.
Connected — identity proven to the relay
No network on this phone. Your messages will wait and go out automatically.
Relay unreachable for now. Retrying automatically.
The relay refused the connection. Please update the app.
Too many connections: the relay is slowing things down. Retrying automatically.
This group is full (64 connected devices).
Invalid relay address. Go back to the MESHORA relay in advanced settings.
The relay never sees the text of your messages (end-to-end encryption). It sees your IP address, times, message sizes, your public key and your display name.
Test version: pre-production relay, no availability guarantee.
Visible to members of your group
You will leave the current group; its members will need a new invitation.
Tor mode: waiting for the Tor circuit. No direct connection is attempted.
On: the relay no longer sees this phone\'s IP address

With Tor, the relay and Cloudflare see a Tor node\'s address instead of yours. Slower, a little more battery. If Tor is not ready, MESHORA waits rather than connecting directly. Message content is end-to-end encrypted either way. Not tested on a phone.

Experimental: not yet tested between two phones. App open and screen on. Range not measured. Only members of your group see your name; other devices only see encrypted data (they can tell a MESHORA device is nearby).
Bluetooth LE is not available on this device.
Bluetooth permissions denied: grant them in the app settings.
Bluetooth is off: turn it on and try again.
Could not open the GATT server.
MESHORA Bluetooth on (%1$s), scanning, %2$d direct link(s).
Bluetooth advertising refused by the system (code %1$d); scanning continues.
This device cannot advertise over Bluetooth LE; scanning continues.
Bluetooth scanning refused by the system (code %1$d).
Your key is created on this phone and stays there, encrypted by the Android keystore.
Read it aloud with a contact: if it matches, nobody is sitting between you.

• ECDSA P-256 / SHA-256 signatures
• End-to-end AES-256-GCM encryption, ephemeral ECDH key per message
• Delivery receipts signed by the recipient
• Private key encrypted by the Android keystore, excluded from backups

• No independent security audit yet
• No forward secrecy yet (if your private key were stolen, previously captured messages could be decrypted)
• The relay sees who talks to whom within a group
• Bluetooth is experimental, not tested between phones
Direct call to official emergency services.
MESHORA does not replace emergency services. If you are in danger, call 112 immediately.
